Name: No Shoes in the house - Bare feet option for Stardew
Author: Amarnaaa
Description:
[center][font=Arial][size=4]﻿Wanted your farmer to walk barefoot?  Don't like them walking into the house with their boots they wore all day on the farm?[/size][/font][font=Arial]

[size=1]( Or just be barefoot all the time no matter what )
[/size][/font]


Pick from two versions to walk around barefoot :


[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ag1kLFI.png[/img]

This version uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] to override the appearance of your footwear to make it look like you're barefoot. You can wear your boots and get the buffs associated while looking like you're wearing no shoes. Use the handmirror in game to switch to this when needed.

  Install Fashion Sense and  dump [FS] Bare Feet in your mods folder. Then find it as an option in game under Shoes in the Fashion Sense menu.

[size=2]( Fashion Sense version does not require Get Glam or the Get Glam version [size=2] of this mod[/size] )[/size]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/hOR1yBw.gif[/img]﻿



[img]https://i.imgur.com/YEvFtBB.png[/img]﻿

This version of the mod uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044]Get Glam[/url]﻿ to change the base of the farmer to have bare feet. Equip-able boots are hidden when on this body type, you still get the buffs it just looks like you're barefoot. You need to use Get Glam/Customize anywhere to switch between shoes / no shoes.

Install Get Glam in your mods folder, dump [GG] Bare Feet in your mods folder as well and you'll see this somewhere in the shoes section of GG.

[size=2]( [size=2]Get Glam[/size] version does not require [size=2]Fashion Sense[/size] or the [size=2]Fashion Sense[/size] version of this mod )[/size]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/SebUpO0.gif[/img]﻿

[font=Arial][size=4]

No more boots in the house, in the bed, or on the beach if you want.[/size][/font][size=1]
[/size][/center][size=2]
